verification.subject: Verify your Coverage Compass account
verification.heading: Check Your Inbox
verification.body: We sent a verification link to {{email}}. Click the link to activate your account and get started with your first policy review.

passwordReset.subject: Reset your Coverage Compass password
passwordReset.heading: Reset Your Password
passwordReset.body: We received a request to reset your password. Click below to choose a new one. If you didn't request this, you can safely ignore this email.

reportReady.subject: Your Coverage Compass report is ready
reportReady.heading: Your Report Is Ready
reportReady.body: Your Coverage Score and educational report for your {{policyType}} policy are ready to view.

renewalReminder.subject: Your {{policyType}} policy renews soon
renewalReminder.heading: Renewal Coming Up
renewalReminder.body: Your {{policyType}} policy renews in {{days}} days. This is a good time to revisit Coverage Compass for an updated review.
